description: This file defines a middleware component for handling exceptions in an ASP.NET Core web application. It intercepts exceptions during request processing and returns JSON-formatted error details with appropriate HTTP status codes.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that captures exceptions during HTTP request processing and returns JSON error responses accordingly.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main method invoked for each HTTP request; forwards the request and catches exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles specific exceptions by setting the appropriate response status code and message, especially for DuplicateException and general exceptions.
